selection: Four focal resources each in Clothing, Employment and Housing, purposively including specialized eligibility, reachable entry routes and possible overlapping housing help. Cross-category membership retained; not representative sampling.
sourceKind: Earlier AI editorial draft; no subsequent human-confirmed package identified in checked saved Mesa ZIPs. Browser-local edits are not asserted captured.
sequence: Primary source recheck, up to 2 official pages per resource; freeze findings.
Targeted second pass for consequential unresolved issues or suspected overlap, at most 8 additional official pages; freeze incremental findings.
Frontier editorial decisions, exact field changes, practical curator questions and partial draft package.
Import editorial and package-comparison evidence; propose a method only for at least 3 independently supported recurring mistakes, retaining counterexamples.
If a method is justified, separately seal a bounded fixed-source test on fresh cases before dispatch; otherwise stop with evidence and no activation.
measurements: Tool call wall time and phase elapsed time (coordinator time separate from model-service time).
Unique material factual corrections, actionable intake clarifications and consequential unresolved gaps, counted by resource/field.
Second-pass supported findings retained by editor versus duplicates and unresolved attempts.
Retain/combine/reserve decisions, with eligibility and differing program access preserved.
No inferred dollar cost, curation-time saving, model comparison or phone verification.
stopRule: One 12-resource batch and one targeted follow-up pass. No positive lesson required; no automatic activation or adaptive scheduling change.
evaluator: Current Codex coordinator, same context and aware of earlier editorial decisions; not blinded.
